scope: Each starts independently at its saved state; one original dt300 attempted step each, paired uninstrumented numerical-equivalence witness; not a continuation trajectory
units_weights: A=dx_2d*dy m2; h0=dz_node*wet_mask_z m; M0=rho0*A*h0 kg; H0=sum(h0); verify dz_norm=h0/H0 on wet columns. Kref=.5 sum M0*(u2+v2) J; Kbt=.5 rho0 sum A*H0*(ubar2+vbar2) J; Kshear=Kref-Kbt. Eeta=.5 rho0*g sum A*wet*eta2 J. Component impulses sum M0*u/v kg m/s are spherical grid-component diagnostics, not conserved Cartesian momentum.
moving_weight: h(eta)=h0+eta*surface_mask*wet; Kmat-Kref=.5 rho0 sum A*eta*(u_surface2+v_surface2). Report its change separately; reference mass governs momentum, moving top mass governs tracer stock. No claim of shared moving-volume physical energy closure.
exact_work: For each retained velocity update a->b with fixed M: deltaK=sum M*((Ua+Ub)/2) dot (Ub-Ua). Tag actual additive increment components using that same endpoint average, Wq=sum M*Umid dot deltaUq J, impulseq=sum M*deltaUq. Sum increment/work residuals against actual update, never fit an unobserved physical source. For a damping/mask map report exact state change, not an invented RHS.
fast: Record all12 actual25s drift-kick-drift substeps. Keep incoming means/eta, first masked means, midpoint eta, pre-damping next means, transported eta, final means/eta, first/second faces and constant predictor density forcing. Kick components: dt*(-g*G eta_mid), dt*density_forcing, dt*tau/(rho0*H0), dt*f*normal_mask*(v_mid,-u_mid), all matching masks. Wind/density/eta impulses and work use kick endpoint midpoint. Each eta drift deltaE=rho0*g sum A*eta_endpoint_mid dot deltaeta. Record pressure+drift exchange defect rather than require an exact unmodified Verlet Hamiltonian invariant; separate frozen-shear face contribution. Record damping, cap, mask and eta-filter maps separately.
retained_path: incoming -> first150s bottom drag -> first material L -> actual N predictor -> predictor L -> fast -> final150s bottom drag -> final wall mask. The material tracer middle/end branch changes final T/S but its separately computed end.u/v are discarded. Do not count that unused momentum branch in the retained velocity ledger.
reliable_subset: Full outer momentum states/increments and their reference-energy changes; exact fast kick decomposition and drift/free-surface energy; two bottom-drag maps and wall constraints. Slow L diffusion+rotation stage and N advection/dealias+pressure+wind residual remain combined unless their actual stages can be captured without changing expressions. Do not label combined stages pure viscosity or pressure. No full6h work closure reconstructed from sparse observations.
density_PE: Historical density anomaly and z datum are fixed, but no buoyancy/vertical-quadrature PE functional compatible with the moving tracer controls and split pressure operator has been established. Report density pressure work as unclosed conversion; sensible heat inventory is not buoyancy PE or kinetic energy.
checks: All source/input/checkpoint hashes; exact-expression preservation under AST projection ignoring diagnostic statements/aux returns; numerical equality of all6 attempted/returned fields with <=1e-11 absolute and identical validity/boolean gates; increment/work/state telescoping; closed exterior face flux; non-positive isolated bottom-drag/mask reference-energy changes; fast midpoint Coriolis work zero within arithmetic bound. No blanket dissipativity assertion for combined L/N stage or advection filter.
arithmetic_bounds: Before execution: eps=float64 epsilon; each sum-based identity bound=4096*eps*max(1,sum absolute endpoint and work terms). Velocity increment residual bound=4096*eps*max(1,max absolute endpoints and component increments). Accumulation bound additionally scales by number of recorded maps. These diagnose arithmetic only, not scientific qualification and do not change existing gates.
missing_fields: Full momentum RHS term decomposition at actual slow RK/Heun stages; raw vs dealiased advection work; complete viscosity/rotation separated map work; compatible buoyancy PE and its thermal/salt/mixing source budget. Record explicitly as missing, not zero.
known_inactive: Original sponge arrays zero, eta relaxation zero, polar cap rows0, nu_bi0. project_adv_vel flag true but symmetric_fast_v3 early-return nonlinear predictor avoids legacy _explicit_full_step column-projection branch; require instrumentation call-count confirmation. Face matching is a tracer flux adjustment, not a state-velocity Poisson projection.
publication: Scalar budget/protocol/source diff only; raw stage arrays remain in private isolated output; no original repository/data/Goal edits, merge or reset cards
